# NPM Improved v1.8.0 — Production

NPM Improved 1.8.0 promotes the complete security-qualified **v1.8.0-beta.11** feature set. This is not based on the old 1.7.x stable source and does not remove any approved beta features.

## Included features
- Unified instance firewall controls and firewall companion, including current DMZ/forwarded policy and reporting.
- NPMX pairing, primary-secondary synchronization, role and identity fixes, reconnect workflows, in-place upgrade compatibility, and UI polish.
- Channel-aware update discovery, firewall alerts, clipboard fallback, and accessibility/color contrast improvements.
- Existing proxy host configurations, certificates, database persistence, and native host-updater support preserved.

## Security baseline
- Privileged Go control plane and companion firewall rebuilt with **Go 1.27.4**, including the November 2026 standard-library fixes.
- Runtime Node.js **24.22.1** and NGINX **1.31.8**, verified inside the final application image.
- Normalized, independently reproducible Node 24.22.1/Yarn 1.22.22 frontend build with the required jq locale tooling.
- AMD64 and ARM64 native container release bundles and updater agent included with verified SHA-256 sums.

## Promotion contract
Production artifacts are *rebuilt* from this source against the exact **v1.8.0-beta.11** feature baseline, downloaded and verified from immutable GitHub Release checksums. They are not simply retagged beta binaries. Both architecture variants require full frontend, backend, Go, firewall and image verification. If GHCR or any archive verification fails, production publication stops.

## Updating
Use Settings → Update on each NPM Improved instance after publication, selecting the **Stable** release channel for v1.8.0. Preserve volumes, reverse proxy hosts, SSL certificates, and NPMX configuration; confirm operational health after installation. No instances are automatically restarted by GitHub release publication.
